### Day 1 – Thu 2027-01-14: Central
**Weather:** light snow, -5.5 to -0.5 °C – walking distance not applicable.
- **23:50 Depart from Helsinki** – Flight with Finnair & SAS (outbound). [details](https://kiwi.com/u/gg6t9tn4v7)

### Day 2 – Fri 2027-01-15: Central
**Weather:** overcast, -7.1 to -3.4 °C – walk ≈ 4.9 km.
- **11:30 Arrive in Longyearbyen** – Same flight as above. [details](https://kiwi.com/u/gg6t9tn4v7)
- **13:15 Barentz Pub & Spiseri** – Mid‑tier lunch; try the Arctic pizza. Budget tier: mid. [info](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)
- **14:00 Galleri Svalbard** – Permanent exhibition of Norwegian Arctic art, historic maps and local currency. Free entry. Indoor. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)
- **16:00 Svalbard Church** – World’s northernmost church, simple interior, small shop. Free entry. Indoor. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)
- **19:30 Restaurant Nansen** – High‑end dinner with Arctic‑inspired menu (reindeer, seal, whale). Budget tier: high. [info](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)

### Day 3 – Sat 2027-01-16: Central
**Weather:** overcast, -8.0 to -2.6 °C – walk ≈ 1.0 km.
- **10:00 Svalbard Museum** – Presents natural and cultural history of the archipelago, from early whalers to modern research. Ticket price: see the website. Open 10:00‑17:00. Indoor. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3526633670)
- **12:30 North Pole Expedition Museum** – Shows polar aviation history, including historic dirigibles and aircraft. Ticket price: see the website. Open 09:00‑17:00. Indoor. [source](https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/4586740390)
- **15:00 Vinterhagen Restaurant** – Mid‑tier lunch; sample the reindeer stew. Budget tier: high. [info](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)
- **16:00 Arctic Husky Dog‑Sledding Tour** – Guided 4 h sledding chasing the Northern Lights. Ticket price: see the website. Outdoor. [info](https://en.visitsvalbard.com/activity-planner/polar-night-dog-sledding-svalbard-husky-p2522333)
- **20:00 Stationen** – Refined Arctic cuisine (whale, fish, burgers). Budget tier: mid. [info](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)
- **22:45 Northern Lights Viewing Spot** – Dark‑sky spot away from settlement lights. Free entry. Outdoor. [info](https://en.visitsvalbard.com/inspiration/various/10-things-about-the-northern-lights)

### Day 4 – Sun 2027-01-17: Central
**Weather:** snow, -8.1 to -0.7 °C (rainy). – walk ≈ 1.3 km.
- **08:30 Gruve 1A Amerikagruva** – Historic coal‑mine ruin (first opened 1906, operated until 1958). Outdoor. [source](https://opentripmap.com/en/card/W686576331)
- **10:00 24‑Hour Sundial** – Unique sundial that tracks the Sun during polar night. Free entry. Outdoor. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)
- **11:00 Mix kiosk** – Quick snack (hot dogs, burgers, sandwiches). Budget tier: low. [info](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Longyearbyen)
- **12:10 Depart from Longyearbyen** – Return flight with Norwegian Air Shuttle & Norwegian Air Sweden. [details](https://kiwi.com/u/jtc68p25j8)

## Food to try
- **Fårikål** – Stewed lamb and cabbage, Norway’s national dish. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Norway#Eat)
- **Lutefisk** – Dried fish reconstituted in lye, a traditional specialty. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Norway#Eat)
- **Smalahove** – Sheep’s head, traditionally served around Christmas. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Norway#Eat)
- **Pinnekjøtt** – Dried mutton ribs, a festive Christmas dish. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Norway#Eat)
- **Tørrfisk** – Dried cod, staple of coastal communities. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Norway#Eat)
- **Klippfisk** – Salted cod, used in many Arctic recipes. [source](https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Norway#Eat)
